result.title: Taurus: LLM-in-the-Loop CT Annotation Matches Coding Agents at Half the Cost
result.comment: 24 pages (10 main text, 12 appendix), 8 figures, 10 tables
result.summary: Dense labels of the aorta in CT are slow to draw, and the public aortic CT datasets that could stand in for them each label different structures under their own conventions. Large language model (LLM) agents can now write code and read images. We asked whether such a model labels these scans better as a free-form agent that writes its own segmentation code, or inside a harness, where an automated pass labels the scan and the model reviews the result. We built a harness, Taurus, and compared it with free-form agents by blind label recovery: we withheld the human labels of six public datasets (939 volumes) and scored every approach against each dataset's own classes. In the first version of Taurus, the model's review raised the primary metric on only two of six datasets, by less than the noise between two reviews of the same case. A free-form agent running Claude Opus 5.5 scored higher on most datasets. Moving what the free-form agents did well into the automated pass then carried most of the gain on 38 held-out cases. The final version smooths the label surfaces with a fixed rule and checks for the large errors the automated pass tends to make, such as an aneurysm drawn to half its size. Each check that fires puts a multiple-choice question to the model, with candidate corrections drawn on the scan. It matched the surface smoothness of the human references, and in the primary metric we found no difference from the free-form Opus agent, at under half its cost, $1.22 against $2.71 per case. Most of what made Taurus competitive came from the harness and its automation rather than from the language model itself. Taurus shows that this kind of annotation can be automated, so that expert time can move from drawing labels to checking them.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Taurus，把 LLM 放进「自动分割流程 + 模型复核」的 harness 中标注主动脉 CT，用六个公开数据集（939 例）的盲标恢复分数与自由写代码的 agent 对比精度与单例成本。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「自动流程先出结果、按规则触发检查再向模型提带视觉候选的多选题」结构，可能可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、按需追加计算与停止/复核决策，但领域与任务较远，迁移仅为推测。
